info.title: e-AROGYATA OPD and Bed API
info.description: Single-hospital portfolio project. All dates use the configured hospital timezone. No real patient data. Refresh tokens use a rotating HttpOnly cookie; unsafe cookie refresh requires an allowlisted Origin. All JSON request objects reject unknown properties. Error bodies use RFC 9457 Problem Details. IDs are opaque positive integers; authorization never relies on obscurity.

Set-Cookie.description: earogyata_refresh=opaque; HttpOnly; Secure (production); SameSite=Strict; Path=/api/v1/auth. The refresh token never appears in JSON.

post.summary: Rotate refresh token and issue access token
post.description: Requires earogyata_refresh HttpOnly cookie and an exact allowlisted Origin. Replay revokes the entire session including current access tokens. No JSON body.

get.summary: Authenticated SSE invalidations; fetch stream with Authorization header
get.description: event: invalidate, data: {"resource":"queue"|"beds"}. Heartbeats use event: heartbeat. No PHI or token in URL. Reconnect and refetch snapshots. Stream terminates no later than access-token expiry; reconnect with renewed access token. At most 4 streams per user and 256 in total. Events are per API instance; 20-second client reconciliation supports multiple instances.
